IEEE-754 decimal interchange format parameters (table 3.5): parameter 32-bit 64-bit 128-bit decimal{k} --------------------------- ---------- ---------- ---------- ---------------- k, storage width in bits 32 64 128 multiple of 32 p, precision in digits 7 16 34 9 * (k / 32) - 2 (or: 3*(t/10)+1) emax 96 384 6144 3 * 2^(k/16+3) (or: 3*2^(w-1)) emin=1-emax -95 -383 -6143 1-emax bias, E-q 101 398 6176 emax + p - 2 sign bit 1 1 1 1 w, exponent bits 6 8 12 k/16 + 4 (or: k-t-6) w+5, combination field bits 11 13 17 k/16 + 9 t, trailing significand bits 20 50 110 15 * (k/16) - 10 (or: k-w-6) k, storage width in bits 32 64 128 1 + 5 + w + t
bits are (from left to right, i.e. MSB to LSB) (figure 3.2): S sign bit G0 first combination field bit (bit #(k-2)) G1 second combination field bit ... G[w+4] final combination field bit (bit #(k-w-6)) T trailing significand bits
value is: (-1)^s * b^e * m where: b is radix of 10 s is 0 or 1 e is any integer emin <= e <= emax m is a string of digits, each d[i] such that 0 <= d[i] < b d0 "." d1 d2 ... d[p-1] (thus it also holds that 0 <= m < b)
viewing the significand as an integer instead, the value is: (-1)^s * b^q * c where: b is radix of 10 s is 0 or 1 q is any integer emin <= (q+p-1) <= emax c is a string of digits, each d[i] such that 0 <= d[i] < b d0 d1 d2 ... d[p-1] (thus it also holds that c is an integer with 0 <= c < b^p)
transformations: e = q + p - 1 m = c * b^(1-p)
